title: Differential spec: explorer emulator vs native gcc vs qemu
description:
features/lessons/differential-cloud.feature, @linux-only, run with npm run test:linux in the runner image. Acceptance:
- for every C program in lessons/**/source/ and lessons/corpus/, /explain at -O0 and -Og run in the explorer Machine, native gcc on the runner, and the /explain ELF in qemu-riscv32 give the same output and exit code (five runs)
- a second scenario fails when any recorded /explain answer is stale (byte-for-byte match on recompile)
- known differences (long, printf %f, sizeof(void *), HashMap) are avoided or tested on purpose
right_now_summary: The team is defining tests to compare explorer, native GCC, and QEMU outputs for every C program.
